purpose: Short actual-physics integration check for Genesis step -> native HDR frame observation -> strict sample assembly -> DVS event packet -> event-only gripper action.
renderer: Genesis Camera.render(radiance=True, depth=True, segmentation=True), native EGL rasterizer

controller.policy: latch gripper-close command on first non-empty packet; otherwise keep gripper open
controller.command_effective: next Genesis physics step after packet return

claim_boundary: Causal plugin call-order smoke in two short Genesis physics rollouts; not a grasp-success test, full task evaluation, or real-time performance claim. Evaluator-only segmentation statistics may describe visibility/shadow changes.
